title: Order the Vulnerability Management Lifecycle
prompt: Put the steps in logical order, from discovering a vulnerability to communicating the result.

items.label: Identification — scan assets (authenticated scan, IPAM, CSPM) and review source code
Prioritization — assess severity (CVSS), exposure, criticality, and review the pentest report
Remediation — apply the patch or implement a compensating control with documented risk acceptance if needed
Verification — rescan using the same method to confirm closure
Reporting — produce internal/external reports and manage bug bounty and responsible disclosure

explain: The official order is identification -> prioritization -> remediation -> verification, followed by reporting. A rescan precedes closure: without verification, there is no proof the patch worked. Reporting then feeds into prioritization for the next cycle.
